title: Initial oracle acceptance
statement: Let $\mathrm{orc}$ be an oracle mapping indices in $\{0,1,2,3\}$ and Boolean strings to truth values, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. The oracle accepts at index $1$ the pair encoding of $x$ and the pair encoding of the binary expansions of $u$ and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle on four indices and Boolean strings
